description: Regression corpus of representative 68K + AREXX doors. Each entry runs via web/backend/src/scripts/run-amiga-door.ts (or the AREXX-direct path), stdout is captured + diffed against goldens/<id>/output.txt. Adding a door: drop it into Doors/, register here, run with --capture to freeze the golden, then run without --capture to verify it stays green.

doors.name: Sent_FE
doors.notes: Banner-only stub door (EMPiRE/MYSTiC X-DESiGN 1994). Loads, renders ANSI banner, issues PRV_COMMAND 'Sent', shuts down. No input expected — pure outbound trace test for XIM JH_REGISTER → SV_NEWMSG → DT_NAME → DT_SLOTNUMBER → BB_NONSTOPTEXT → JH_SM* → PRV_COMMAND → JH_SHUTDOWN sequence. Verified 2026-05-11.

doors.name: Conftop
doors.notes: Conference Top Uploaders v2.3 (Bobo/Mystic + Looby/Insane). Exercises XIM banner + dos.library file I/O for Conf.DB reads + AEDoor message flow. Without Conf.DB seed data, exits early with 'Reset date is out of range' — stable trace either way. Verified runs to completion + emits banner 2026-05-11.

doors.name: WHO v2.0
doors.notes: WHO v2.0 by Spy/MST. Renders who's-online header banner then queries active nodes. Exercises XIM BB_MAINLINE / ACTIVE_NODES / MULTICOM ops + DT_SECSTATUS user-field path. Non-interactive, exits cleanly. Verified deterministic 2026-05-12.

doors.name: AquaWho

doors.name: 5D-AutoFree V0.01
doors.notes: SvEN/5D 1994 file-check / auto-free door. Without its full .info tooltype set, the door's icon.library GetDiskObject lookup fails and it exits with 'Door hasn't been started fully right!' Pinned here as a deterministic 5-XIM-op trace (JH_REGISTER → SV_NEWMSG → BB_MAINLINE → JH_WRITE × 2 → JH_SHUTDOWN). Surfaced by bulk-probe 2026-05-12.
